screens.title: Campaigns
screens.caption: Every campaign with its progress, outcomes and cost per minute — the agent calls inside 30 seconds of an enquiry or on a schedule you set.

screens.title: Live calls
screens.caption: Calls in progress with stage, sentiment and the transcript as it happens — a supervisor can listen in or take over with one click.

screens.title: Call log
screens.caption: Every call becomes a record: transcript, sentiment, entities, next action — and the CRM write that happened because of it.

screens.title: Agent script · Anjali
screens.caption: The script is plain language: opening, goal, language mix, objections and the rules for handing over. Your sales head edits it, not an engineer.

screens.title: Handovers
screens.caption: Handover is designed in: the person gets the transcript, the sentiment, the CRM card and a suggested line — and joins the call or calls back within a promised time.

screens.title: Reports
screens.caption: Connect rates, outcomes, cost per minute and per hot lead — measured, not estimated, and compared against the human desk it replaced.

screens.title: What the call wrote
screens.caption: A call is only useful if it changes a record. Every outcome writes to your CRM, sends the WhatsApp follow-up and books the calendar — automatically.
